changes.why: queueShapefileSetTx: a published part (.shp, .shx, .dbf, .prj, .cpg by name, bytes agreeing for the first three) finds its stem's live parts (same case, latest source revision, same name minus extension, case-insensitive, folder path included); a duplicate extension rests every part with words naming it; a missing .shp, .shx or .dbf rests every part waiting; a full set queues SH2's job on the .shp item with an id from the .shp item and the sorted member SHA-256s, and the other parts rest read with the .shp. The job input, convert request and lineage gain an additive members array (shapefile_set only); a job whose members are no longer the live set writes nothing
nativeDerivativeFormat gains shapefile_set (a shapefile card whose original is named .shp); the shapefile draft-limit words no longer point at a bounded API route
one hook before the draft queue: a shapefile part of a stem holding a .shp or .shx takes the set path and is neither drafted nor read as a table; a lone .dbf keeps today's table path
one argument: the job's pinned members passed to convertNativeLayers
